accessClassesNote: KD-037 access classification. Every incumbent is D on ratification day because no controlling-terms capture had been taken for any of them; an empty evidence field means exactly that and is not an oversight. D holds a candidate out at admission and is reported for an incumbent -- publication is blocked by C, by a class-B source under a commercial commercialPosture, and by any catalogued source with no record. Audit order and the initial queue are in KD-037; classification never follows supply pressure. For authoritative A, B or C, evidence is a repo-relative path plus a record key, '<capture artifact>#<candidateId>/<evidenceType>', resolving from the exact Git-index bytes to one successful structured capture; a bare URL, failed capture, fabricated path, untracked file or unstaged replacement is insufficient. Class B additionally requires the full canonical 19-pattern negative-search inventory. Evidence must use the reviewed source's site/feed host unless additionalEvidenceHosts plus evidenceHostReason explicitly records a legitimate legal or parent-company relationship. Those records also require an access-review-v1 sourceFingerprint binding the reviewed source id, name, feedUrl, siteUrl and liveAdapter. D may omit evidence and fingerprint because it authorises nothing and means evidence was insufficient.
